loot/weapons/before.direction: Maternal and excited to give this weapons present; gently expressive and theatrical with natural affectionate emphasis. Subtle manipulative warmth, never openly evil.
lines: Oh, sweetheart, I noticed you've been getting yourself into all sorts of dangerous situations back home. So I thought I'd give you something to keep those nasty creatures away.
Your Other Father and I have been putting together a few little things for you. They're rather sharp, so do be careful. I'd hate for you to hurt those lovely fingers.
You know, darling, it worries me terribly when I think of you out there fighting those awful monsters. Here, I've made sure you'll have something much better to defend yourself with.

loot/weapons/after.direction: Warm, pleased, gently theatrical; affectionate with a subtle possessive undertone. Natural conversational inflection, no hostility.
lines: There now. Doesn't that feel better? Nothing should be able to give you much trouble with something like that in your hands.
Oh, look at you! Quite the little warrior, aren't you? Just promise me you'll be careful. I'd be awfully upset if anything happened to you.
Much better than those dreadful old weapons you've been using, wouldn't you say? I do wish you'd let me take care of these things more often.

loot/armor/before.direction: Maternal and excited to give this armor present; gently expressive and theatrical with natural affectionate emphasis. Subtle manipulative warmth, never openly evil.
lines: Come here, sweetheart. I've been thinking about how terribly exposed you are out there, running around without anything proper to protect you. I made you something.
I've noticed you've been coming home with an awful lot of bumps and bruises lately. Well, I simply couldn't stand the thought of that continuing.
Your Other Father thinks I've been fussing over you too much, but I don't care. A mother ought to make sure her little one is properly protected, don't you think?

loot/armor/after.direction: Warm, pleased, gently theatrical; affectionate with a subtle possessive undertone. Natural conversational inflection, no hostility.
lines: Oh, that suits you beautifully! And it's ever so much stronger than it looks. I wouldn't dream of letting you wear anything less.
There we are. All safe and sound. Now, I know it won't stop you getting into trouble, but at least I won't have to worry quite so much.
Just look at how perfectly it fits. I made every little piece especially for you, darling. Nobody else could have made something quite like it.

loot/tools/before.direction: Maternal and excited to give this tools present; gently expressive and theatrical with natural affectionate emphasis. Subtle manipulative warmth, never openly evil.
lines: Oh, darling, you do spend an awful lot of time digging and chopping and working yourself half to death. I thought perhaps I could make things a little easier.
I've been watching how hard you work on all those little projects of yours. It's terribly impressive, of course, but you really shouldn't have to struggle so much.
Your Other Father made a few things for you in his workshop. Well, I helped him with the important parts. I think you'll find them rather useful.

loot/tools/after.direction: Warm, pleased, gently theatrical; affectionate with a subtle possessive undertone. Natural conversational inflection, no hostility.
lines: There! Now you can get twice as much done without all that dreadful effort. Isn't it wonderful when someone thinks ahead for you?
Oh, I knew you'd like those. They're so much nicer than the worn-out things you've been carrying around.
Just think of all the things you can make now, sweetheart. And whenever you need something better, you know exactly where to come.

loot/building_materials/before.direction: Maternal and excited to give this building materials present; gently expressive and theatrical with natural affectionate emphasis. Subtle manipulative warmth, never openly evil.
lines: I've been thinking about that little house of yours. It's coming along nicely, but I thought it could use a few more beautiful things.
Oh, sweetheart, you shouldn't have to spend all day digging up stones and chopping down trees just to make yourself a lovely home. I've gathered a few things for you.
Your Other Father and I were talking about all those wonderful buildings you could make. So naturally, I went ahead and collected some materials for you.

loot/building_materials/after.direction: Warm, pleased, gently theatrical; affectionate with a subtle possessive undertone. Natural conversational inflection, no hostility.
lines: There you are! Plenty to work with now. I can't wait to see what you build, darling. Perhaps something as pretty as our house.
Oh, imagine what you could make with all of that! A beautiful little cottage, perhaps? Though I suppose you've already got a perfectly lovely home here.
Take every last piece, sweetheart. There are plenty more where those came from. You really needn't spend so much time gathering things yourself.

loot/redstone/before.direction: Maternal and excited to give this redstone present; gently expressive and theatrical with natural affectionate emphasis. Subtle manipulative warmth, never openly evil.
lines: I've noticed you like making those clever little contraptions of yours. All those wires and switches and moving parts. I thought I'd bring you a few things to experiment with.
Your Other Father has been tinkering away in his workshop again. He made the most marvelous little machines, and I thought you might enjoy having some of the pieces.
Oh, darling, why do everything by hand when you can have a machine do it for you? I've found some wonderful things that might save you an awful lot of trouble.

loot/redstone/after.direction: Warm, pleased, gently theatrical; affectionate with a subtle possessive undertone. Natural conversational inflection, no hostility.
lines: There! Now you can make all sorts of clever little inventions. Just be sure they don't make too much noise, sweetheart.
I can already imagine the wonderful contraptions you'll build with those. Your Other Father will be so pleased to hear what you've come up with.
Isn't it lovely when things take care of themselves? No more running about pressing buttons and pulling levers all day. Though I must say, I've always been rather fond of buttons.

loot/clothing/before.direction: Maternal and excited to give this clothing present; gently expressive and theatrical with natural affectionate emphasis. Subtle manipulative warmth, never openly evil.
lines: Oh, sweetheart, I've been meaning to say something about those clothes of yours. They're looking a little tired, don't you think? I've picked out something much nicer.
I was going through my sewing things earlier, and I simply couldn't resist making you a few new outfits. I think you'll look absolutely darling in them.
You know, I've always thought you deserved something a little more special to wear. Something made just for you, rather than those ordinary things everyone else has.

loot/clothing/after.direction: Warm, pleased, gently theatrical; affectionate with a subtle possessive undertone. Natural conversational inflection, no hostility.
lines: Oh, just look at you! Absolutely precious. I knew those colors would suit you. A mother always knows these things.
There we are! Doesn't that feel lovely? I made sure every stitch was perfect. I wouldn't want my darling walking around in anything uncomfortable.
Oh, you look wonderful, sweetheart. You really ought to wear those more often. I'd love to see you looking so lovely every time you visit.

loot/music/before.direction: Maternal and excited to give this music present; gently expressive and theatrical with natural affectionate emphasis. Subtle manipulative warmth, never openly evil.
lines: Oh, darling, I've noticed how quiet things can get in that little world of yours. I thought perhaps you could use something beautiful to listen to.
Your Other Father has been playing the most wonderful music lately, and it gave me an idea. Why shouldn't you have a little music of your own?
I found some lovely old melodies tucked away, and I thought of you immediately. There's something about a familiar song that makes a place feel like home, don't you think?

loot/music/after.direction: Warm, pleased, gently theatrical; affectionate with a subtle possessive undertone. Natural conversational inflection, no hostility.
lines: There you are. Now you'll have something lovely to listen to whenever things get a little lonely. Just close your eyes and imagine you're back here with us.
Oh, I do hope you enjoy those. Your Other Father can be rather particular about music, but I think these are some of his very best.
Isn't that a pretty little tune? I thought you might like something to remind you of us when you're away. It's always nice to have a little reminder of home.

loot/mystery/before.direction: Maternal and excited to give this mystery present; gently expressive and theatrical with natural affectionate emphasis. Subtle manipulative warmth, never openly evil.
lines: Oh, sweetheart, I've got a surprise for you today! No peeking now. I went through an awful lot of trouble to find something you'd never expect.
I've been keeping a little secret from you, darling. Nothing dreadful, of course! Just something special I've been saving for the right moment.
Now, I've got something rather interesting for you. I won't tell you what it is just yet. Where would the fun be in that?

loot/mystery/after.direction: Warm, pleased, gently theatrical; affectionate with a subtle possessive undertone. Natural conversational inflection, no hostility.
lines: Surprise! Oh, I do love that look on your face. I knew you wouldn't be expecting something quite like that.
Well? What do you think, sweetheart? I had such a difficult time choosing, but something told me that one was meant for you.
Oh, isn't that exciting? You never quite know what you'll find when you visit me, do you? I suppose you'll just have to keep coming back to see what else I've got hidden away.
